description: Phase noise and integrated phase noise with spurs removed (conventions: Phase noise with spurs removed; ADR 0115).

cases.source: by hand: Jacobi-Anger lines every 16 bins from -200 Hz, m = 0.3, plus a spur of amplitude 0.01 at +24 bins; the band holds lines k = +-1, +-2 and the spur
by hand: as spur_kept, the spur's 9 bins on each side replaced by a line between the bins at +-5, each on a neighbouring line's skirt (ADR 0115)
by hand: as spur_removed, then 26 bins, whose lower edge is a bin already interpolated for the first
by hand: a real cosine at 256 bins, m = 0.01 at 20 bins, a spur at +12; the upper edge (+17) is on the k = 1 line's skirt
by hand: a real carrier at 470 Hz, tones at 500 and 508 Hz; the 508 group's upper edge is past fs/2 so the group takes the lower edge's value; 470 + 60 is past the spectrum, so that side is skipped
by hand: as integrated_phase_noise.spur_kept; L at 24 bins reads the spur
by hand: L at 24 bins reads the middle of the interpolated line, the mean of the edges; at 16 bins the PM line, untouched
9 bins is within 2w + 1 of the carrier
